tasks.title: Add auth dependencies to mobile
tasks.description: Add @hcengineering/account-client (workspace:^), expo-secure-store, zustand, @tanstack/react-query to mobile/package.json. Run rush update.
acceptanceCriteria: mobile/package.json contains @hcengineering/account-client, expo-secure-store, zustand, @tanstack/react-query
rush update completes without errors
import { getClient } from '@hcengineering/account-client' resolves in Metro

tasks.title: Server config loader
tasks.description: Implement server config loading in src/client/config.ts. Self-contained fetch of {url}/config.json (do NOT import from @hcengineering/api-client). Export getServerUrl(), loadServerConfig(), getConfig(), clearConfig(). Memory-cache config after first load. Define the full ServerConfig interface: { ACCOUNTS_URL: string, COLLABORATOR_URL: string, FILES_URL: string, UPLOAD_URL: string }.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0
acceptanceCriteria: getServerUrl() returns EXPO_PUBLIC_HULY_URL or 'https://app.huly.io'
loadServerConfig() fetches /config.json and returns object with ACCOUNTS_URL
Network failure throws descriptive error (not silent null)

tasks.title: Account client wrapper
tasks.description: Create src/client/account.ts. Export getOrCreateAccountClient(token?) that loads server config, calls getClient(config.ACCOUNTS_URL, token), caches instance. Export clearAccountClient() to reset cached client and config.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0
acceptanceCriteria: getOrCreateAccountClient() returns AccountClient with server config loaded
Calling getOrCreateAccountClient(token) with new token creates fresh client
clearAccountClient() resets state so next call re-fetches config

tasks.title: Auth Zustand store
tasks.description: Create src/store/auth.ts. Zustand store with token, account, isAuthenticated, isBootstrapping. Actions: setAuth(LoginInfo) persists to expo-secure-store, clearAuth() deletes keys, restoreAuth() reads from secure store. Throw if loginInfo.token undefined in setAuth.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0
acceptanceCriteria: setAuth() persists auth_token and account_id to expo-secure-store
restoreAuth() reads from secure store and sets isAuthenticated true when tokens exist
setAuth() throws if loginInfo.token is undefined (tfaRequired case without token)

tasks.title: Workspace Zustand store
tasks.description: Create src/store/workspace.ts. Zustand store with selectedWorkspace, workspaceUrl, workspaceEndpoint, workspaceToken. Actions: setWorkspace(WorkspaceLoginInfo) persists 4 keys to secure store, clearWorkspace() deletes all, restoreWorkspace() reads all 4.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0
acceptanceCriteria: setWorkspace() persists all 4 keys to expo-secure-store and updates state
restoreWorkspace() populates state only when ALL 4 values present (partial = no workspace)
clearWorkspace() removes all 4 secure store keys and resets state to null

tasks.title: Session restore and splash hold
tasks.description: Add session restore logic to root layout. On mount call restoreAuth() then restoreWorkspace(). Keep splash visible until restore completes. Only then hide splash and render Stack. Root layout now: load fonts + restore auth + hide splash.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0
acceptanceCriteria: Splash screen stays visible until restoreAuth + restoreWorkspace complete
If secure store has valid tokens isAuthenticated is true before first render
If secure store empty isAuthenticated is false and splash hides normally

tasks.title: Auth guard in (app) layout
tasks.description: Create app/(app)/_layout.tsx with auth guard. Check isAuthenticated and selectedWorkspace. Redirect to /(auth)/login or /(auth)/workspace-select via declarative <Redirect>. When authenticated with workspace, render a minimal placeholder layout: a simple Stack navigator (no tabs) with a 'Loading workspace...' screen. Tracker phase TASK-004 will later REPLACE this file with the full tab navigator. This ensures the auth phase works standalone without tracker routes.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated access to (app) route redirects to /(auth)/login
Authenticated without workspace redirects to /(auth)/workspace-select
Authenticated with workspace renders Stack with placeholder 'Loading workspace...' screen (no flicker)
Layout uses simple Stack navigator (no tabs) -- tracker phase TASK-004 will later replace with tab navigator

If token present call setAuth() and navigate to workspace-select. Include OTP login link. KeyboardAvoidingView, SafeAreaView, accessibility labels.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0

tfaRequired response -> navigates to 2FA screen with account context
Invalid credentials -> error message displayed form NOT cleared

tasks.description: Create app/(auth)/otp.tsx. Two-step: email -> loginOtp() -> OTP input -> validateOtp() -> setAuth() -> workspace-select. Countdown timer from OtpInfo.retryOn. textContentType oneTimeCode for autofill. Extend use-auth.ts with requestOtp and validateOtp.

acceptanceCriteria: loginOtp(email) sends code and UI transitions to OTP input step
Valid OTP -> setAuth() called -> navigates to workspace-select
Resend disabled until retryOn timestamp passes with countdown visible

tasks.title: 2FA verification screen
tasks.description: Create app/(auth)/two-factor.tsx. 6-digit TOTP input. Calls accountClient.verify2fa(code) using token from initial login response. On success calls setAuth() with verified LoginInfo. Extend use-auth.ts with verify2fa action. Pass initial LoginInfo via route params or transient Zustand field.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0
acceptanceCriteria: Valid TOTP code -> verify2fa() returns LoginInfo with token -> setAuth() called
Invalid code -> error message displayed input cleared for retry
Back navigation returns to login screen not stuck in 2FA loop

tasks.title: Workspace selection screen
tasks.description: Create app/(auth)/workspace-select.tsx and src/hooks/use-workspace.ts. Fetch workspace list via getUserWorkspaces() with TanStack Query. Render list of active workspaces. On tap call selectWorkspace(url), store in workspace Zustand store, navigate to /(app) (the app group root -- NOT /(app)/tracker, which does not exist until the tracker phase). Handle loading, error, empty states. Filter disabled/non-active workspaces.

tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error' || echo 0
acceptanceCriteria: After logout all 6 secure store keys are deleted
